title: Status
description: Telemetry published by the pump every 2 seconds.

uptime_ms.description: Milliseconds since boot. The hub adds wall-clock time on receipt.

rate_ml_hr.description: Rate the pump is currently set to.

delivered_ml.description: Volume delivered in the current feed, from motor steps.

alarm.description: Null when there is no active alarm.

prescription_version.description: Version currently applied. 0 means none yet.

pending_version.description: Version queued until the pump is idle, or null.

level_pct.description: Independent bag level estimate from the level sensor, if fitted.

simulated.description: True when this message comes from the simulator or uses simulated delivery.
